summary: Tested the real (non-demo) mode end to end against the public URL. Backend: 12 live API tests in /tmp/iter15/test_iter15.py, all passing on the first clean run except 1 test-script issue (GET /deadlines defaults to scope=open), which was fixed and re-verified. Results: /developer/status providers = import manuale / import XML manuale / dall'home banking / da configurare (titolare) / spento / Claude, with no 'demo' anywhere. /auth/me features are all off and ai=claude. POST bank-accounts/connect returns 400 and POST invoices/sync-sdi returns 400. Manual account plus CSV statement import (7 movements) works. FatturaPA XML import of an attiva and a passiva invoice works. A reminder sent with no mailbox returns 200 status=non_configurata, and with fake SMTP credentials returns 400 with a clear message. Manual authorize returns {ok, manual:true}, the deadline stays da_pagare with authorized_at, and mark-done sets it to pagato. Email settings: PUT without a password returns 400, a bad from_addr returns 400, a valid PUT works, and the password is never returned. The SMTP test with fake Aruba credentials returns 400 after about 5s, last_test.ok=false, and dev status changes to 'casella attiva'. /settings/email returns 403 for the commercialista and the developer (GET, PUT and test). The assistant gives real Claude answers with tool calls (saldi, scadenze, 3-7s). Receipt OCR read merchant, total 5,80, VAT 0,53 and date correctly. Frontend (Playwright, owner, collaborator and developer with TOTP): all requested flows passed. Two minor UI state-refresh bugs and one rendering issue were found (Claude markdown shown as raw text).

minor.issue: reads_receipts is computed as ai.name == 'anthropic', so it returns False with AI_PROVIDER=claude (EmergentClaudeAI.name='claude') even though receipt reading works. The frontend doesn't use it today, but the flag is wrong.

With no mailbox configured the reminder is still pushed into invoice.reminders (status non_configurata), so 'Solleciti' shows '2 · ultimo ...' and the button becomes 'Nuovo sollecito' even though nothing was sent. Consider not counting unsent reminders, or labelling them 'non spedito'.
In manual mode the requester (collaborator who prepared the payment) gets no notification. Only the automatic path notifies them.

The mailbox config is a single global doc (id='email') that any is_owner user can overwrite. Fine for a single titolare, but multiple owners exist (iteration 14), so there is no per-owner ownership or audit view beyond the audit log.

ui_bugs.issue: After a failed 'Invia prova' the error box shows correctly, but the 'Ultima prova ... non riuscita' line (email-last-test) does not appear until the page is reloaded, because cfg is not refetched after the failed test.
After saving the mailbox, the orange notice 'Le email non partono ancora...' stays visible until a reload. onSaved={reload} doesn't refresh the notification prefs (channels.email).

Claude replies contain Markdown (**bold**, '|---|' tables, '- ' lists), which is shown as raw text. Either render markdown or tell the model in SYSTEM to answer in plain text without tables or asterisks.

design_issues.screen: Scadenzario / Nuova scadenza, Scontrini, Conto manuale
issues: Native <input type='date'> is used (nd-date, rc-date, ma-date) instead of a shadcn calendar picker
In manual-deadline rows with 3 actions, 'Elimina' wraps onto a second line (row height jumps)

action_items: Render assistant answers as markdown, or force plain-text answers in the Claude system prompt
EmailSettings: refetch /settings/email after a failed test so the 'Ultima prova · non riuscita' line shows immediately
Settings: refresh notification prefs (channels.email) after the mailbox is saved so the orange notice disappears
Don't count non_configurata reminders as sent solleciti (or label them)
critical_code_review_comments: assistant.py status(): reads_receipts = ai.name == 'anthropic' should be ai.name in {'anthropic','claude'}
receivables.send_reminder: status non_configurata is stored as a reminder, which inflates reminders_count
deadlines.authorize_payment manual branch: no notify() to the requester and no audit of who prepared it
Brute force lockout (429 after 5 fails), CORS (no allow-origin for a foreign origin) and the bcrypt $2b$ hash in .env were verified OK

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows functional; 3 minor UI issues
